title: Demonic Transformation
description: A surreal painting depicts a tormented humanoid figure split into multiple colored demonic forms. The central being has a pale face with closed eyes, a green skeletal torso, a red muscular arm, and a blue clawed hand, all dripping paint. Dark smoke emanates from its head while it clutches its chest, set against a bedroom scene with a haunted bed and purple curtains.
